note: Clarke County's zoning map is published only through its web page and a CAMA Vision viewer (maps.camavision.com/clarkeia), which exposes no ArcGIS REST zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Clarke County or Osceola zoning returned no queryable district layer, and the Iowa geodata clearinghouse listed none.
